title: Barbarin brothers, nephew Danny Barker and the family of musicians
summary: He lists his brothers, sister Rose's son Danny Barker, and nephews who play trumpet and trombone.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I have a brother we just lost about a year or so ago. His name is Lucien Barberang. He died. And I have a brother that's now playing with the, with our Papa Selle's Dance Band, on the direction of Edith Pearson. His name is Lewis Barberang. Then I have another brother that plays a pretty good trumpet. But I don't know, he, he just rather work in there, before working in the daytime, and fooling with the trumpet, I guess, I don't know. I don't understand him. His name is Willie Barberang. He doesn't play very much? No, he doesn't play very much. He plays pretty good too. He knows all the tunes, most all the old tunes. And his name is Willie Barberang. I did say that, yeah.
How old is Willie? He's the youngest, he's the youngest boy. I imagine he's about 47, something like that, yeah.
And Louie's a couple of years younger than you or so?

Yeah, I was a couple of years younger than me, just about a couple of years. And then we have, in the family we have my nephew, which is my sister Rose, who passed away a couple of years ago. Her son Danny Barker, and everybody says he's pretty good guitar and banjures. Played with all the named bands around New York. He's still in New York. He's trying to get his book together. Which I hope he does. Because I'm tired of hearing about that book.
That'll be a good one now when he gets it.

It'll be a good one, I think, when he gets it. I've heard him talk about it. Then I have a couple of nephews. One is a trumpet player, his name is Charlie Barberang. That's my brother Lucian's son. Then I have another nephew that's a wonderful trombone player. He's a New York City work post office. His name is Louie Barberang. That's Louie's son. That's Louie's son. So, it's a lot of musicians in the family.
